headline: Sanctioned Tankers Deliver Fuel to Houthi-Controlled Yemen Terminal
summary: Windward intelligence data revealed that 12 sanctioned tankers delivered an estimated 3.26 million barrels of fuel to the Red Sea terminal of Ras Issa between September and November 2026, with most operating with AIS location transponders disabled.
why: Enforcement of maritime sanctions on petroleum shipments to Red Sea ports affects geopolitical risk premia and regional shipping security.
